name: General Information 9
definition: Information concerning the negotiation process leading to a treasury trade.

BlockIndicator.name: Block Indicator
BlockIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the trade is a block or single trade.

RelatedTradeReference.name: Related Trade Reference
RelatedTradeReference.definition: Reference to a preceding transaction, for example, an option or swap.

DealingMethod.name: Dealing Method
DealingMethod.definition: Method used by the trading parties to negotiate and/or execute a deal.

BrokerIdentification.name: Broker Identification
BrokerIdentification.definition: Specifies the broker which arranged the deal between the trading side and the counterparty side or, when two money brokers are involved, between the trading side and the other money broker.

BrokersCommission.name: Brokers Commission
BrokersCommission.definition: Brokerage fee for a broker confirmation.

SenderToReceiverInformation.name: Sender To Receiver Information
SenderToReceiverInformation.definition: Specifies additional information for the receiver and applies to the whole message.

DealingBranchTradingSide.name: Dealing Branch Trading Side
DealingBranchTradingSide.definition: Specifies the branch at the trading side with which the deal was done.

DealingBranchCounterpartySide.name: Dealing Branch Counterparty Side
DealingBranchCounterpartySide.definition: Specifies the branch at the counterparty side with which the deal was done.

ContactInformation.name: Contact Information
ContactInformation.definition: Specifies the name and/or electronic address of the receiver of the message who may be contacted for any queries concerning this trade.

AgreementDetails.name: Agreement Details
AgreementDetails.definition: Specifies the type, date and version of the agreement used in a trade.

DefinitionsYear.name: Definitions Year
DefinitionsYear.definition: Specifies the year of definitions of the agreement.

BrokersReference.name: Brokers Reference
BrokersReference.definition: Specifies a reference applied to the trade instruction by a broker.

PaymentClearingCentre.name: Payment Clearing Centre
PaymentClearingCentre.definition: Specifies the place of clearing for offshore currency trades.||Usage: Used to designate the clearing centre for offshore currency trades. It must not be used for trades that settle onshore.

CalculationAgent.name: Calculation Agent
CalculationAgent.definition: Specifies the party that will act as calculation agent for a cash-settled trade.
